messages:
Ava (AE): heads-up — XCorp procurement says they can only accept purchases via Azure Marketplace. they also want a 20% commit discount on a 12mo commit. can the discount show up on the Azure invoice under our vendor entity? cc @Raj
Raj (Sales Eng): marketplace invoices are tricky — by default Azure invoices show Microsoft as the billing party. to get net pricing on the invoice we generally need a private offer (custom pricing) or transactable offer that maps to our publisher/vendor id. do we have vendor_id for XCorp?
Olga (XCorp Procurement): procurement requirement: single PO to vendor "Redwood, Inc" and marketplace invoice must include our PO number and our GL code line-item. we cannot accept a separate Microsoft line-item.
Marta (Finance): FYI — finance: marketplace charges flow through Azure and reconciliation lists Microsoft unless private offer configured. private offers can surface custom pricing on the customer's invoice, but will require publishing a private plan and marketplace onboarding steps. also need tax and VAT fields confirmed.
Ethan (Deal Desk): Deal desk can approve a private-offer discount if it fits ratecard override rules. Need legal signoff for any special payment terms (they asked for NET60). please raise a deal-desk ticket with the committed ARR, target price, and desired payterm.
Lisa (Sales Ops): operational note — creating a private offer + customer acceptance typically takes ~3–5 business days (marketplace team + buyer acceptance). I can kick off the private-offer request once we have an approved price and the buyer's tenant/publisher info.
Ava (AE): commit details: $240k ARR (equiv $20k/mo), 12 months, customer explicitly wants the net price to appear on Azure invoice. they also require a single PO and procurement clause for data residency.
Raj (Sales Eng): OK — private offer looks like the path. will need: vendor_id (our publisher id), offer_id, buyer_tenant_id, and the PO attached. draft az CLI to create private-offer:

az commerce private-offer create \
  --publisher-id <PUBLISHER_ID> \
  --offer-id <OFFER_ID> \
  --private-offer-name "XCorp-12mo-commit" \
  --price 200000 \
  --buyer-tenant-id <BUYER_TENANT>

(note: values are placeholders, marketplace team will verify final formatting)
procurement-bot: checklist — vendor_id, offer_id, private_offer_id, buyer_PO, tax_info. docs: https://aka.ms/marketplace-private-offers :memo:
Olga (XCorp Procurement): one blocker — our legal can only approve marketplace purchases if the invoice lines map to our internal contract numbers. will legal accept an addendum or does Redwood need to add specific clause in the private-offer?
Marta (Finance): we can request invoice mapping (custom line-item metadata) but Azure has limits. if mapping is required and marketplace can't provide it, fallback is direct invoicing from Redwood (outside marketplace) — but you said procurement won't allow that.
Ethan (Deal Desk): approval in principle — we can do a private offer + special terms addendum. next steps: 1) Ava to upload a sample PO and buyer tenant id. 2) Raj to draft private-offer payload and price. 3) Lisa to file deal-desk ticket and loop in marketplace ops. 4) Legal to review addendum for data residency and payterm.
Ava (AE): I'll get the PO and tenant id today and upload to the ticket. will also ask procurement to confirm required GL codes.
Lisa (Sales Ops): I'll open the deal-desk ticket now and tag marketplace ops + legal. ETA to submit private-offer to MS: EOD tomorrow if we have the PO.
Olga (XCorp Procurement): thanks — we'll push PO internally and confirm GL mapping. one last ask: can the private offer include a 12-mo commit + clause for mid-term headcount adjustments?
Raj (Sales Eng): that can be represented in the offer pricing, but contractual flexibility for headcount usually goes in the MSA/addendum. legal will need to handle that.
Marta (Finance): also note: committing to marketplace private offer means revenue recognition rules differ slightly; finance needs the final contract before booking.
Ethan (Deal Desk): I'll queue the approval and flag special-payterm/net60. once we have docs, I'll route to legal.
Ava (AE): great — thanks everyone. will update when I have PO + tenant id. :thumbsup:
